newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin practically ready for surgery - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin practically ready for surgery - Kremlin.

text.p: Doctors have nearly completed the preparations for Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation and the president's health is "completely satisfactory", a medical report released by the Kremlin said on Monday.
"B.N. Yeltsin's health is completely satisfactory," the statement said. "The preparations for the operation are practically over."

The statement, signed by Kremlin medical chief Sergei Mironov, said doctors, including U.S. specialist Michael DeBakey would meet to sum up the preparations for surgery and work out what had to be done.
It said Yeltsin's temperature was normal and his blood pressure was stable.

Yeltsin said on September 5 he would have an operation on his heart and doctors have been busy preparing him for surgery since then. DeBakey said last week that blood and thyroid problems had been overcome and he expected the operation to take place this week.
